SELECT E.EVENT_ID AS eventId, E.TITLE AS title, E.CONTENT AS content, DATE_FORMAT(E.START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(E.END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, EI.IMG_URL AS img_path FROM event E LEFT JOIN event_img EI ON E.EVENT_ID = EI.EVENT_ID AND EI.IS_MAIN = 'Y'
AND E.END_DATE >= NOW()
AND E.END_DATE < NOW()
AND E.END_DATE < NOW()
ORDER BY E.END_DATE ASC
ORDER BY E.END_DATE DESC
ORDER BY E.START_DATE DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event
AND END_DATE >= NOW()
AND END_DATE < NOW()
AND END_DATE < NOW()

SELECT E.EVENT_ID AS eventId, E.TITLE AS title, E.CONTENT AS content, DATE_FORMAT(E.START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(E.END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, EI.IMG_URL AS imgPath FROM EVENT E LEFT JOIN EVENT_IMG EI ON E.EVENT_ID = EI.EVENT_ID AND EI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE E.EVENT_ID = #{eventId} LIMIT 1

SELECT IMAGE_ID AS eventImgId, IMG_URL AS imgUrl, IS_MAIN AS isMain, SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder, EVENT_ID AS eventId FROM EVENT_IMG WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} AND IS_MAIN = 'N' ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, IMAGE_ID ASC

SELECT event_id AS eventId, title, content, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate FROM event
WHERE start_date <= CURDATE() AND end_date >= CURDATE()
ORDER BY end_date ASC LIMIT 5
